sentences.text:
Reference may be made to the order dated 26.11.2021 which reads as  under:
"The contempt case is taken up today through Video conferencing.
A show cause affidavit has been filed on behalf of the opposite party no. 2 stating inter alia that in pursuance of representation dated 22.03.2021 filed by the petitioners in terms with order dated 01.03.2021 passed by this Court in W.P.(C) No. 210 of 2021, the matter was enquired in presence of the petitioners by issuing memo no. 466/L.A. dated 01.04.2021 to the Project Director, NHAI, PIU,
Durgapur (W.B.) requesting him to furnish a report regarding acquisition and utilization of actual land of the petitioners as the petitioners were claiming compensation for 5 decimals of land,
whereas they were paid compensation for only 1 decimal of land as per notification dated 27.11.2013 issued under Section 3D(1) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

been issued to the Project Director, NHAI, PIU, Durgapur (W.B.) requesting inter alia to send the said report,
however, the same has not yet been received from the Project Director due to which the claim of the petitioners towards redressal of their grievance could not be taken up under the provisions of the Act, 1956.
Mr. M.M. Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioners, submits that under the said circumstance, the Project Director, NHAI, PIU, Durgapur (W.B.) may be allowed to be impleaded as opposite party no.

Subsequently, the case was taken up on 25.02.2022 and on the said date, learned counsel for the O.P.No.3 [the Project Director, National Highway Authority of India, NH-02, PIU Durgapur,

entities.text: National Highway Authority of India, NH-02, PIU Durgapur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Burdwan (West Bengal)] was directed to file the show cause affidavit within four weeks.

However,
no show cause affidavit has yet been filed on behalf of the said O.P.
Hence, the O.P.No.3 is directed to file show cause/compliance affidavit within two weeks positively, failing which he shall remain physically present before this Court on the next date fixed.
Put up this case on 11.08.2023 under the heading ''For Admission''.

Satish/- (RAJESH SHANKAR, J)
